title: Pennsylvania measles outbreak accelerates with 55 new cases, expanding northeastern spread
detail: Pennsylvania's measles outbreak reported 55 new cases since Wednesday September 23, 2026, accelerating the trajectory of the state's resurgence and expanding the geographic reach across the northeastern United States. Pennsylvania had already overtaken South Carolina as the year's largest single-state outbreak by mid-September, and the latest surge signals continued spread to new counties.
